title: Study of the video on the karamat of al-Jilani
text: 8 inferences and the video's stories, tested on repo v54. 3 inferences hold, 1 is mixed, 3 are overstated, 1 is unsupported. The stories fall in four groups. In the hagiographies (al-Tadifi's Qalaʾid, with hits in al-Shattanawfi's Bahja, OCR): the infant's fast in Ramadan (qalaid r00005-r00006), the ox and ʿArafa and the forty dinars (r00014), twenty-five years in the wilds (r00029, r00017), Khidr's seven years (r00006), the chicken (r00058; it speaks the shahada, and the closing line differs), the jinn and the girl (r00049; she is abducted from a roof in 537, not 'troubled'). In the sober biographers: seventy thousand at his gathering (Siyar 20:447), Ibn Qudama's and Ibn ʿAbd al-Salam's witness, the death scene. Not found by the wordings searched (folders jilani, wilaya, critics, sahaba, asma, sufi_manuals; the Bahja is OCR and may hide some): the dead man raised for the Christian, the locksmith's other life, iftar in many houses at once, the drunk man's three questions, Hizb al-Nasr, the robe left for Naqshband, the dream that moved him from the Shafiʿi school, the Prophet at the pulpit. Contradicted: al-Dhahabi gives birth 471 and age ninety, died 10 Rabiʿ II 561 (the video: 470 and 91); he studied law under the Hanbali al-Mukharrimi from his youth; Ibn al-Jawzi has him teaching and preaching in that school until he died, so the wandering came before the preaching (the order from general knowledge). Caution: 'Bahjat al-asrar' in the Siyar and the Mizan is Ibn Jahdam's book, not al-Shattanawfi's. Not searched: Rumi's and Ibn ʿArabi's seats, the creed works, the commentaries on 27:40. Every Arabic wording for the stories came from Claude's memory. Case record: docs/jalasa/cases/2026-10-03-jilani-karamat.md
